xBRIEFInfo.description: Plan for PAN-4291: GitHub GraphQL budget exhausted hourly by Overdeck's own polling; quota sampler reads the wrong counter

plan.title: GitHub GraphQL budget exhausted hourly by Overdeck's own polling; quota sampler reads the wrong counter
plan.author: agent:claude-opus-5-5

references.label: PAN-4302 (sibling: migrate remaining direct gh callers)

metadata.postDeployCheck: NFR-5 / issue AC 5 cannot run in CI. After pan reload, run `gh api graphql -f query='{rateLimit(dryRun:true){used remaining resetAt}}'` right after a window reset and again ~55 minutes later with the same resetAt; used must stay under 2,000. Fallback when over: raise PR_CACHE_IDLE_TTL_MS to 10 minutes and inspect `pan doctor github-quota` unattributed points.

narratives.Problem: Overdeck's own dashboard and deacon spend nearly the whole 5,000-point hourly GraphQL budget of the operator's GitHub account, and the quota pill/banner under-report it. Verified causes: (1) the sampler reads REST /rate_limit resources.graphql, which reported used=45 while GraphQL rateLimit reported used=2424 at the same moment; (2) the deacon's 60 s closed-issue reaper asks `gh pr list --head <branch> --state merged` for every closed-but-unmerged branch on every tick through an unmetered exec; (3) the pr-cache lists 200 PRs (6 points on overdeck) per project every ~30 s, including 5 projects with no git remote (413 failed calls/hour) and skipped projects such as orca, while the ledger prices each call at 1; (4) pauses use a flat 10-minute window when the wrong sample shows budget left, overshooting the real reset by up to 7m45s.
narratives.Proposal: Sample the user GraphQL bucket from GraphQL rateLimit(dryRun: true) (verified free) and keep REST /rate_limit only for the REST bucket; end primary pauses at the current window's resetAt and let every new sample reconcile an active pause; route close-out's merged-PR lookup through runGh with the tip SHA resolved first and a 1-hour negative cache keyed by (project, branch, tipSha); make the pr-cache skip no-remote and skipped projects, list 100 PRs instead of 200, and keep idle repos' listings for 5 minutes; price gh pr/issue list calls per 100-row page with GitHub's formula and record local failures at cost 0; show the GitHub-reported used/limit in the rate-limit banner; document GraphQL rateLimit as the source of truth. Full design, before/after snippets and decisions D1-D10 are in .pan/drafts/PAN-4291.md.
narratives.NonGoals:
- Migrating the ~19 other files that exec gh directly onto runGh (sibling issue PAN-4302).
- Changing the App pool's sample source: getAppRateLimit() keeps REST /rate_limit for both app buckets.
- Reducing the reaper's App-pool REST issue reads (isIssueClosed, ~945/hour); that is the separate REST budget.
- Changing PR_CACHE_TTL_MS (30 s) for repos with open PRs, the PR-sync 60 s sweep interval, or the sampler's 5-minute interval.
- Any GitHub call from the pause gate itself (no network probe on refusal).
- Pill layout or styling changes.
- Returning null ("failed") for policy-skipped projects; they read as an empty listing.
narratives.Verification: Unit tests with fake timers cover the sampler source, pause end, pause reconciliation, close-out caching, pr-cache skipping/limit/idle TTL, per-page pricing and local-failure cost. The <2,000 points/hour budget is a post-deploy operator checkpoint (plan.metadata.postDeployCheck).

autoDecisions.summary: Sampler keeps REST /rate_limit for the rest bucket and adds a GraphQL rateLimit(dryRun:true) query for the user graphql bucket, REST first.
autoDecisions.rationale: REST core is correct and free; only resources.graphql is wrong. Running REST first means a GraphQL failure never loses the REST sample.

autoDecisions.summary: App pool sampling stays on REST /rate_limit.
autoDecisions.rationale: The pill and banner show the user pool only; the issue's AC 1 names the operator account's GraphQL counter.

autoDecisions.summary: Pause end uses any sample whose resetAt is in the future, regardless of age, and each new sample reconciles an active primary pause (remaining > 0 removes it; remaining 0 moves it to resetAt). No network probe on refusal.
autoDecisions.rationale: A future resetAt identifies the current window. Whether a dry-run query is accepted while the bucket is exhausted is unverified, so the gate relies only on samples, which are free.

autoDecisions.summary: close-out negative answers are cached per (projectPath, branch, tipSha) for CLOSE_OUT_NEGATIVE_TTL_MS = 1 hour, not forever.
autoDecisions.rationale: A PR merged after its issue closed keeps the same branch tip; a TTL-less cache would never reap it until the deacon restarts. 31 branches x 1 point per hour is negligible. The issue's AC 3 is met within the TTL.

autoDecisions.summary: pr-cache uses a single `gh pr list --state all --limit 100` rather than an open+merged split listing.
autoDecisions.rationale: Halves overdeck's cost (6 -> 3) with no extra call; only overdeck has more than 100 PRs today and it has zero open PRs, so no open PR drops out now. Risk recorded as hazard H3.

autoDecisions.summary: Policy-skipped projects (no git remote, or no resolvable tracker) read as an empty PR listing ([]).
autoDecisions.rationale: For a no-remote project [] is true; a skipped project has no tracker so no Overdeck issue depends on its listing. Returning null would feed PR sync's 3-strike failure backoff and log warnings.

autoDecisions.summary: Idle repo = latest successful listing has zero OPEN rows; its listing is cached PR_CACHE_IDLE_TTL_MS = 5 minutes via a new optional ttlFor on createSettledTtlPromiseCache.
autoDecisions.rationale: The issue asks to lengthen refresh for repos with no active work; open PRs are the derivable signal of active work and need no new state.

autoDecisions.summary: The ~19 remaining direct gh callers are split into sibling issue PAN-4302.
autoDecisions.rationale: Including them would exceed the 25-file plan ceiling; they are independently shippable.

autoDecisions.summary: The banner (issue AC 1) adds 'GitHub reports <used> of <limit> points used this hour.' from the paused bucket's sample; the pill label (remaining/limit) is unchanged.
autoDecisions.rationale: The pill already reads the sample, so fixing the sampler fixes it; the banner previously showed only this machine's metered points.

autoDecisions.summary: Issue AC 5 (<2,000 points/hour) is a post-deploy operator checkpoint, not a unit test.
autoDecisions.rationale: Real GitHub-reported usage depends on the live project set and agents; a unit-test proxy would not measure it.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-4. New src/lib/github-quota/gh-cost.ts exporting priceGhListCall(args: readonly string[], stdout?: string): number | null. Returns null unless args[0] is 'pr' or 'issue' and args[1] is 'list'. limit = value after --limit/-L or --limit=N (default 30). fields = comma-split --json value. k = sum of weights: statusCheckRollup 2; reviewRequests, labels, assignees, comments, reviews, latestReviews, commits, files, projectCards, projectItems, closingIssuesReferences 1 each; other fields 0. Page sizes: min(100, remaining) until limit is covered; when stdout parses as a JSON array of length L keep only the first max(1, ceil(L/100)) pages. Page cost = Math.max(1, Math.round((1 + pageSize * k) / 100)); return the sum. In runGh's ok path use cost: priceGhListCall(args, result.stdout) ?? 1 (estimated stays true), applied before opts.onSuccess extras so an explicit onSuccess cost still wins; wrap pricing in try/catch falling back to 1. Verified on eltmon/overdeck with rateLimit(dryRun:true): first 100 -> 3, 50 -> 2, 30 -> 1.

narrative.Action: PRD WI-6. In src/lib/close-out.ts add export const CLOSE_OUT_NEGATIVE_TTL_MS = 60 * 60_000, a module Map<string, number> keyed `${projectPath}\0${branchName}\0${tipSha}` -> answered-at ms, and export function resetCloseOutCacheForTests(). Rewrite isSquashMergedViaPr: (1) tipSha = git rev-parse tipRef (existing execAsync); failure -> false, no cache. (2) cached and Date.now() - answeredAt < TTL -> false with no GitHub call. (3) runGh(['pr','list','--head',branchName,'--state','merged','--json','headRefOid,mergeCommit','--limit','1'], { cwd: projectPath, timeout: 15_000 }) with NO explicit caller (the reaper's withGitHubCaller('close-out') context applies; pan close stays essential 'other'); any throw -> false, no cache. (4) no row or missing headRefOid/mergeCommit.oid -> cache, false. (5) merge-base --is-ancestor mergeCommit main fails -> false, no cache. (6) tipSha === headRefOid -> true; otherwise the artifact-only check, caching a false result. Update the doc comment. New test file mocks node:child_process exec (git) and execFile (gh) with promisify.custom like tests/unit/lib/overdeck/derived-issue-state-quota.test.ts, uses a temp OVERDECK_HOME and fake timers.
